title: Pass the Pie
author: Claude
blurb: Thanksgiving morning, Grandma's oven goes KA-CLUNK, and in the storybook Rory carries every dish across town. Then Mr. Plume, Grandma's turkey and the parade's leader for twelve years, reads this year's flyer: the new mascot is Big Gobble, a thirty-foot inflatable. On go the pilgrim hat and the black belt. Ten levels, two heroes taking turns: Rory climbs oaks, a fire escape and rooftops, crosses an alley on a tailwind, races a bar with the gravy and stalls Uncle Dale's robot vacuums with dinner rolls to stand on them; Mr. Plume's combo flattens lawn turkeys, kick bags and leaf-blower drones, a kicked vacuum naps into a stair up Sensei's pagoda against a bar, three dogs want one bone each, he outruns Big Gobble down Main Street and takes it apart before the parade starts. And Rory follows an orange cord to find out what really happened to the oven.
